pt-trees-s13.png.prompt:
Game sprite sheet for a 2D storybook game: 4 separate deciduous trees in a single row, evenly spaced with wide empty gaps of background between them, nothing overlapping, nothing touching the edges of the image, every tree standing on one invisible horizontal ground line, each one a separate cut-out game sprite. Each crown is a cluster of big rounded faceted balls of foliage in olive, sage and yellow-green, lighter on top and darker underneath; the trunk is grey-brown with a little fork, short, visible below the crown:
1) a large old tree with a wide crown of three overlapping faceted foliage balls and a thick forked trunk
2) a medium tree with one big round faceted crown on a straight trunk
3) a small young tree with one small round faceted crown on a thin trunk
4) a tall tree with two faceted foliage balls stacked one above the other

Faceted look: crowns and stones are built from flat painted planes, like a low-poly sculpture painted in watercolor, every facet a slightly different wash of the same colour, thin brown ink lines along the facet edges — a painting, not a 3D render.

Camera: HIGH ANGLE, the same for every drawing: the viewer stands above and looks down at about 35 degrees, like the camera of an isometric top-down game (Don't Starve) — each object is seen from the side and a little from above.

Art style: hand-drawn storybook illustration made with a dip pen and watercolor — uneven brown-black ink outlines with a little scratchy hatching, loose transparent watercolor washes with soft blooms and a little paper grain, muted warm earthy palette (ochre, olive green, sage, umber, rust, dusty red, dusty lilac), slightly exaggerated whimsical proportions in the spirit of Don't Starve. Flat even light, no cast shadows. Do not paint glow, light rays, fire, smoke, mist or water effects into the picture — the game engine draws them. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no frame. Plain flat uniform light grey background (#c8c8c8), no ground patch, no soil, nothing under the feet.
